title: CapagentReportV1
description: Authoritative machine-readable report format for container host compatibility evaluations (Schema v1).

schema_version.description: Canonical schema major version integer (fixed to 1 for Schema v1).

context.description: Evaluation execution context summarizing target user identity and environment boundaries.

uid.description: Target Linux User ID (UID) under which capability evaluations are assessed.

gid.description: Target Linux Group ID (GID) under which capability evaluations are assessed.

is_rootless.description: Whether evaluations execute under non-root unprivileged namespace constraints.

in_container.description: Whether the evaluation environment is itself running within an outer container.

host.description: Observed host-level kernel, distribution, cgroup, and init system facts.

os.description: Normalized operating system ID (e.g. rhel, fedora, ubuntu, debian, alpine).

architecture.description: Host hardware architecture (e.g. x86_64, aarch64, arm64).

cgroup_version.description: Cgroup hierarchy operational mode on the host.

systemd.description: Whether systemd init is active as PID 1 on the host.

runtimes.description: Observed container runtimes discovered on the host environment.

installed.description: Whether the runtime executable exists on host PATH or standard locations.

version.description: Reported version string of the runtime.

accessible.description: Whether the runtime service or socket is accessible by the target identity.

network_backend.description: Configured network backend driver (e.g. netavark, cni).

storage_driver.description: Active graph/storage driver (e.g. overlay, overlay2, vfs, btrfs, zfs).

capabilities.description: Evaluated canonical capabilities mapped to operational state, confidence, and evidence.

confidence.description: Degree of confidence in capability determination based on evidence hierarchy.

reason.description: Human-readable diagnostic reason explaining determination or root cause.

evidence.description: Deterministic list of supporting evidence identifiers.
